```{r}
#| label: fig-fu-out
#| fig-cap: "Association between outcomes at follow-up and bilirubin (unadjusted)"
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false
#| fig-subcap:
#| - CVD/HFH at 12 months
#| - All-cause death at 12 months
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| layout-nrow: 1

splinefunc <- function(outvar, outtime, outname, mod, ylims = NULL) {
  if (mod == "cox") {
    modmy <- coxph(
      formula(paste0(
        "Surv(", outtime, ",", outvar, "== 'Yes') ~ ns(Bili_mgdL, df = 4)"
      )),
      data = escdata
    )
  }
  if (mod == "nb") {
    modmy <- glm.nb(formula(paste0(outvar, " ~ ns(Bili_mgdL, df = 4) + offset(log(", outtime, "))")),
      data = escdata %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(outtime))),
    )
  }

  tp <- termplot(modmy, se = TRUE, plot = F, terms = 1)

  plotdata <- tp$Bili_mgdL

  center <- with(plotdata, y[x == 1.2])

  xlims <- seq(0, 5, 1)
  if (is.null(ylims)) {
    ylims <- log(c(0.1, .7, .8, 0.9, 1, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 5))
  } else {
    ylims <- log(ylims)
  }

  plotdata <- plotdata %>%
    mutate(
      est = y - center,
      lci = y - global_z05 * se - center,
      uci = y + global_z05 * se - center,
      lci = if_else(lci < min(ylims), min(ylims), lci),
      uci = if_else(uci > max(ylims), max(ylims), uci)
    )

  if (!is.null(ylims) & !is.null(xlims)) {
    if (any(plotdata$est[plotdata$x <= max(xlims)] > max(ylims)) |
      any(plotdata$est[plotdata$x <= max(xlims)] < min(ylims))) {
      stop("est is smaller or larger than ylims")
    }
  }
  if (mod == "cox") {
    yname <- "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)"
  }
  if (mod == "nb") {
    yname <- "Rate Ratio (95% CI)"
  }

  p <- ggplot(plotdata, aes(x = x, y = est)) +
    # geom_hline(yintercept = log(1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1.2, linetype = 2, color = "black", linewidth = 0.75) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, color = global_cols[1]) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lci, ymax = uci), fill = global_cols[1], alpha = 0.3, linetype = 0) +
    geom_rug(sides = "b") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
        color = "lightgrey",
        linewidth = 0.5,
        linetype = 2
      ),
      text = element_text(size = 22, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
    ) +
    labs(x = "Bilirubin (mg/dL)", y = yname) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = xlims,
      limits = c(min(xlims), max(xlims)),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = ylims,
      limits = c(min(ylims), max(ylims)),
      labels = exp(ylims)
    )

  if (output) {
    create_pptx(p)
  }
  p
}

splinefunc(outvar = "cvdhfh_fu", outtime = "time_death_fu", "CVD/HFH", mod = "nb", ylims = c(0.4, .6, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5))
splinefunc(outvar = "death_fu", "time_death_fu", outname = "Death", mod = "cox", ylims = c(0.4, .6, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5))
```
